# routes

Synthetic GPX/GeoJSON tracks for the scenario simulator. They were generated by script from
straight legs around the synthetic origin (45.0 N, 7.0 E). They are not real traces and are not
derived from any (invariant I2).

- `expressway-inbound.gpx`: 6.5 km due north at 29 m/s, a point every 100 m with UTC timestamps.
- `walk-two-corners.geojson`: a 1 km walk with two right-angle corners (LineString).
